text.tspan: Reasoning · A² A1 · cycle role collaboration
An agent can reason and use an external action
The model emits reasoning followed by an action
Parsed action, execution result, and observation
External evidence enters the reasoning trajectory
Action and observation schemas are stable
Every executed action has an attributable
Model reasoning is not treated as
Invalid action, unavailable tool, or parse
error is exposed to the loop.
1 reason(state) → 2 choose(action) → 3 act(action) → 4 observe(result) → 5 continue(observation) → 6 observe(state)
Evidence: 39/41 repositories, 35/36 families; 39 trajectories (19 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: Prompt protocol, typed tool call, XML or text parser, and observation compression.
Negative control: Chain-of-thought text without external action is not ReAct.
